caption: The drawing depicts a metal object, primarily brown and rust-colored, comprised of a flat base with two curved, claw-like hooks at each end. Extending upward from the base are four parallel, upright metal bars joined by a horizontal connecting bar, forming a framework. A long, straight rod with a flat, rounded end and a hole near its tip is attached to the framework with a visible hinge or pivot mechanism near the top center, allowing it to swing. Below the main object, there is a precise line drawing of a similar long-handled rod, annotated with measurements (½" = 3"), and the name "Florence Stevenson" written next to it. The drawing is rendered on a light beige background with some areas of discoloration and staining near the edges.
title: Iron Toast Rack
